source: retail raw/ quest/single/dive/quest_0010S00.rel + quest/random_dungeon.rel; semantics from data/re_reference/level_generation_algorithm.json (FUN_02031ce8 three-pass merge, resolved live via DTCM breakpoint)
merge_rule: arm9 default 0x020ec2d8 <- random_dungeon.rel overlay (pass 2) <- per-area sparse diff (pass 3, sentinel = inherit: negative for bytes 0..8/0x0a, 0xFE for byte 9 and the picker loop). The merged block exists only as a DTCM stack local at generation time.
target_rule: target = min + rand(max-min); branches = pair[0] + rand(pair[1]-pair[0]); budget identity target = 2*branches + spine + 1 (FUN_02083378); growth stops at placed >= target, one extension pass when short

1.note: branch pair (2,2) skips the branch draw entirely (max==min); (2,3) draws rand(1)=0 - branches are ALWAYS 2

2.note: branch pair (2,2) skips the branch draw entirely (max==min); (2,3) draws rand(1)=0 - branches are ALWAYS 2

3.note: branch pair (2,2) skips the branch draw entirely (max==min); (2,3) draws rand(1)=0 - branches are ALWAYS 2

4.note: branch pair (2,2) skips the branch draw entirely (max==min); (2,3) draws rand(1)=0 - branches are ALWAYS 2

5.note: branch pair (2,2) skips the branch draw entirely (max==min); (2,3) draws rand(1)=0 - branches are ALWAYS 2

6.note: branch pair (2,2) skips the branch draw entirely (max==min); (2,3) draws rand(1)=0 - branches are ALWAYS 2

7.note: branch pair (2,2) skips the branch draw entirely (max==min); (2,3) draws rand(1)=0 - branches are ALWAYS 2

random_dungeon_overlay.weights_note: weight index i is selected by a picker byte; value is the per-10000 chance. weights[4]=800 is the coliseum rate read by the E-transition builder (8%)

5.note: COLISEUM - never via the picker; placed by the E-transition builder at 8% (weights[4]=800/10000)

wave_count_rule: FUN_02057794 (banked, pszm-decomp): count = ctx_min + game_rng(ctx_max - ctx_min + 1) - INCLUSIVE range on the combat RNG (PszRng). ctx min/max are the [w3, w4] fields of the per-room wave records in enemy_room_assignment.json
